items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: He also recorded it with Milt Jackson and a trumpet player, Henry Boozier on the Prestige label in March 1954.

ctx.x: Opus de Funk was composed by Horace Silver. It was recorded by him with a trio for Blue Note in 1953.
He also recorded it with Milt Jackson and a trumpet player, Henry Boozier on the Prestige label in March 1954.
There's also a version of it on a Savoy record which has Milt Jackson and Frank Wess.
